description: This file defines a final class 'MimeType' for handling MIME type mappings based on file extension. It includes a static mapping array of extension to MIME type, and functions to retrieve MIME types from filenames or extensions.

classes.name: MimeType
classes.description: A utility class for mapping file extensions to MIME types using a static associative array and static methods.

methods.name: fromFilename
methods.description: Returns the MIME type for a given filename by extracting its extension and looking up the mapping.

methods.name: fromExtension
methods.description: Returns the MIME type for a given file extension from the static mapping array.
